candidates.title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping
candidates.reason: multi-candidate speculative decodingで拒否後に残差分布がdraftからずれるResidual Driftを補正し、出力分布の厳密性を保ったまま提案分布を再整形する。既存multi-candidate法比で最大1.92倍高速化。

candidates.title: AsymSpec: Efficient Cloud-Edge Speculative Decoding over Asymmetric Networks
candidates.reason: edge draft/cloud verifier構成で非対称回線を前提にverification protocolとconfirmed-prefix pipelineを共同設計し、最強baseline比2.82–28.03倍のoutput-token throughputを報告。通信律速推論の直接研究。

candidates.title: Bole: Efficient Tree Speculation for Hybrid-Attention Language Models
candidates.reason: hybrid-attention LLM向けtree speculationをkernel/runtime共同設計し、linear-attention tree verificationを3.4–7.7倍高速化、speculative state memoryを82–99倍削減。SGLang統合でoffline decode最大4.72倍。

candidates.title: D-cut: Adaptive Verification Depth Pruning for Batched Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: 高並行batchで長いdraftの無駄なverification計算をcross-request confidenceとruntime cost modelで削減。MoEを含む環境で平均speedupを1.26倍から1.65倍へ改善し最大3倍。

candidates.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
candidates.reason: factorized drafterのtop-K marginalから軽量autoregressive adapterでproposal treeを構築し、Gated Delta Net向けrollback-free tree verificationとCUDA kernelをSGLangへ実装。自己回帰復号比4.37倍、DFlash比24.7%高速化。
